about.leadText: “I exist in the quiet space where the heartbeat of a poem meets the mathematical harmony of sound, and the precision of code breathes life into art.”
paragraphs: With 7+ years of architecting software systems as Mahaveer Jain, creation is a seamless continuum. When midnight arrives, the fountain pen inks raw emotions into Hindi and Urdu couplets. Those words naturally demand a melody, turning into songs, acoustic riffs, and Sufi undertones.

The song then begs for a visual universe — leading to custom album artwork, typography posters, and cinematic video edits under Badtameez Music. And underneath it all, the engineering mind builds the systems, audio DSP tools, and software architectures that empower these digital experiences.
about.philosophyQuote: “Fann (art) is the destination; technology is the vessel that sails the uncharted sea.”

songs.title: 1. Shodh
songs.subtitle: Original Philosophical Rap · Mahaveer Jain
songs.description: A profound poetic search into identity, truth, existence, and the restless human spirit.
songs.lyrics:
[Shodh — Lyrics by Mahaveer Jain]

Talaash khud ki, talaash sach ki,
Kagaz pe behti hui ek aanch ki.
Duniya ki bheed mein khoya nahi main,
Dard mila par soya nahi main.

[Chorus]
Yeh shodh hai rooh ka, alfaaz ka,
Yeh shodh hai dil ke har raaz ka.
Naram dil, garam alfaaz,
Bas yahi hai apna andaaz!

[Outro]
Lakeeron se aage jahaan apna hoga,
Har lafz mein sach ka sapna hoga.

songs.title: 6. Aao Naa
songs.subtitle: Soulful Romantic Ballad
songs.description: An intimate and tender melodic poetry capturing the depth of romantic longing.
songs.lyrics:
[Aao Naa — Lyrics by Mahaveer Jain]

Khamosh shaam hai, thehri hawa,
Teri kami ki bas yahi hai saza.
Aankhon mein khwaab hain tere sanam,
Dhadkan mein gholein ek meethi dawa.

[Chorus]
Aao naa, paas aao naa,
Dil ki yeh pyaas mitao naa.
Naram dil, garam alfaaz,
Bas yahi hai apna andaaz!

[Verse 2]
Kagaz pe likh diya tera hi naam,
Har subah teri hai, teri har shaam.
Do pal jo thehro mere rubaru,
Mil jaaye meri rooh ko aaraam.

songs.title: 10. Shiv-Shiv
songs.subtitle: Devotional Cosmic Energy
songs.description: A powerful ode to the cosmic dancer, vibrating with transcendental chants and divine devotion.
songs.lyrics:
[Shiv-Shiv — Lyrics by Mahaveer Jain]

Dam dam damroo baaje re,
Gale mein naag biraaje re.
Neelkanth Mahadev trikaal,
Karta sabka kalyan re.

[Chorus]
Shiv-Shiv, Har-Har Bhole,
Man ka har ek bandhan khole.
Naram dil, garam alfaaz,
Bas yahi hai apna andaaz!

[Stanza]
Kailash pati, shambhu avinaashi,
Goonjti hai jinki dhun Kashi.
Bhakti ki dhaar mein beh jaaye mann,
Paawan ho jaaye yeh jeevan-dhan.

songs.title: 11. Kaalia Freestyle
songs.subtitle: Raw Flow & Aggressive Wordplay
songs.description: Unfiltered fire, fearless cadences, and raw lyricism. Mahaveer's 'garam alfaaz' in pure sonic form.
songs.lyrics:
[Kaalia Freestyle — Lyrics by Mahaveer Jain]

Mic pe aate hi banti hai aag,
Kalam se likhte hain apna bura ya bhala bhag.
Na dare kisi se, na jhuke kabhi,
Har beat pe goonjti apni hi rag.

[Chorus]
Kaalia flow, tezi se chalta,
Har lafz yahaan aag sa jalta.
Naram dil, garam alfaaz,
Bas yahi hai apna andaaz!

[Verse 2]
Rhythm aur rhyme ka yeh kaisa fitoor,
Har ek misra karta guroor ko choor.
Badtameez Music ki apni hai dastaan,
Chhoo ke dikha do humara aasmaan!

written.linesHindi:
दर्द की दो दवा बहर का क्या करूँ!
साँसों में गुल रहा ज़हर का क्या करूँ!

क़ैद लगती है इस शहर में साँस भी,
लोग सब हैं बुरे शहर का क्या करूँ!

ये दवा है नहीं कर्ज़ हैं कोई तो,
जान महँगी लगे असर का क्या करूँ!

हर्फ़-दर-हर्फ़ जज़्बात लिखता हूँ मैं,
कायदे इतने इस हुनर का क्या करूँ!
written.linesRoman:
Dard ki do dawa bahar ka kya karun!
Saanson mein gul raha zehar ka kya karun!

Qaid lagti hai is shehar mein saans bhi,
Log sab hain bure shehar ka kya karun!

Ye dawa hai nahi karz hain koi to,
Jaan mehngi lage asar ka kya karun!

Harf-dar-harf jazbaat likhta hoon main,
Qaide itne is hunar ka kya karun!

written.linesHindi:
तुमने ही शायद ये आसमान सजाया लगता हैं।
चाँद क्या मुझको हर एक तारा तेरा साया लगता हैं।

कितना बुरा हैं, बचपन मे तो ऐसा नही था वो,
दुनिया ने उसको शायद बहुत सताया लगता हैं।

दूर बहुत है शहर तेरा मेरे शहर से मेरी जान,
जेब मेरी खाली और काफी किराया लगता हैं।
written.linesRoman:
Tumne hi shayad ye aasman sajaya lagta hai.
Chaand kya mujhko har ek taara tera saaya lagta hai.

Kitna bura hai, bachpan me to aisa nahi tha wo,
Duniya ne usko shayad bahut sataya lagta hai.

Door bahut hai shehar tera mere shehar se meri jaan,
Jeb meri khaali aur kaafi kiraya lagta hai.

written.linesHindi:
ख़ुद ही को जो परखते है छुपके-छुपके।
रोने वाले भी हँसते है छुपके-छुपके।

वक़्त ले आता हैं फ़ासले जिनके दरमियाँ,
अनजाने में बिछड़ते है छुपके-छुपके।

जो हँसकर मिलते है रकीब से अपने,
शब-भर आहे भरते है छुपके-छूपके।

जिन बीजो को मिलता नही कोई बागबां,
वो कीचड़ में खिलते है छुपके-छूपके।
written.linesRoman:
Khud hi ko jo parakhte hai chhupke-chhupke.
Rone wale bhi hanste hai chhupke-chhupke.

Waqt le aata hain faasle jinke darmiyan,
Anjaane mein bichhadte hai chhupke-chhupke.

Jo hanskar milte hai rakeeb se apne,
Shab-bhar aahein bharte hai chhupke-chhupke.

Jin beejon ko milta nahi koi baagban,
Wo keechad mein khilte hai chhupke-chhupke.
